Monaco.description: Monaco is an AI-native revenue platform for startups that replaces legacy CRM and sales point solutions — building TAM, running outbound, capturing interactions and managing pipeline in one place. (monaco.com)

Paid.description: Paid is a billing and pricing platform for AI agent companies: "Align pricing with value. Protect margins. Grow revenue." (paid.ai)

Artisan.description: Artisan automates outbound sales with an AI-first platform powered by AI employees, including an AI BDR. (artisan.co)

Vendo.description: Vendo (YC S26) embeds an agent in your product that lets customers automate work, build their own views and connect tools inside your brand and guardrails. (vendo.run)

Pocket FM.description: Pocket FM is an audio series platform offering serialized audio dramas — fantasy, thrillers, romance and more. (pocketfm.com)

Apify.description: Apify offers thousands of tools for web scraping and automation — real-time web data, competitor tracking, lead generation and integrations for apps and AI agents. (apify.com)

OpenAI.description: OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company, maker of ChatGPT. (Sponsor of this banner not confirmed.)

GLHFDD.label: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
GLHFDD.description: Feature film directed by Gore Verbinski; the banner was a promotional stunt for its release.

Uber.description: Uber is a ride-hailing and delivery platform. Banner sightings were mostly South Bay (San Jose/Cupertino/Fremont).

Pylon.description: Pylon is a B2B customer-support platform. Its aerial ad was a drone airship (not a towed banner).
